nr2_001: A brief downpour had just passed outside.
nr2_002: A young woman in her mid-twenties folded her umbrella and approached Hoshimi Hospital's reception desk in high heels. Her short hair was neatly styled, and she wore a fitted navy business suit with a medical-device company visitor badge pinned to her chest.
nr2_003: “Good afternoon. Do you have an appointment?”
nr2_004: “Mika Shimotsuki, two thirty. I contacted your purchasing office. I'm here to deliver our catalogue of new surgical instruments.”
nr2_005: The receptionist looked down to check the register.
nr2_006: “Ah, yes. Please wait a moment while I contact the surgeon assigned to meet you.”
nr2_007: Mika maintained a polished professional smile, but her gaze drifted past the desk toward the clinical corridor as if by chance.
nr2_008: “I heard your hospital recently recruited Dr. Sakaguchi from overseas, an exceptionally versatile surgeon, and that your surgical volume has grown sharply. Once our company heard, we hurried over with our newest instrument catalogue.”
nr2_009: “Dr. Sakaguchi certainly has been busy lately. It's lucky your company sent a woman. Our hospital has an unusual custom and normally doesn't let male sales representatives into the clinical area.”
nr2_010: “A colleague mentioned that before I came, so I was assigned to this account.”
nr2_011: Her reply was perfectly natural, though she continued watching the staff moving through the corridor as she spoke.
nr2_012: At the far end of the hall, Narumi Jinguji walked past carrying a chart.
nr2_013: The moment Mika saw Narumi's face and name badge, her gaze paused almost imperceptibly. She quickly looked away and lowered her head to straighten the folder in her hands.
nr2_014: Narumi did not break stride. With an unchanged expression, she turned into the surgical nurses' station.
nr2_015: Ren Nanase was checking the afternoon supply sheet. Seeing Narumi enter, she looked up softly.
nr2_017: “Has the saleswoman who just registered at reception ever done business with our hospital?”
nr2_018: Ren glanced at the internal routing form:
nr2_019: “No. The register says this is her first visit. She used Dr. Sakaguchi's arrival and the expansion of surgery as an opportunity to bring a catalogue of new gynecologic and pelvic surgical instruments.”
nr2_020: Narumi's fingers paused lightly at the edge of the chart.
nr2_021: “Her first visit… Yet when we passed in the corridor, her first reaction to seeing me wasn't how someone looks at a complete stranger.”
nr2_023: “…Could she simply have recognized your name?”
nr2_024: “Perhaps I'm overthinking it. One look alone proves nothing.”
nr2_025: She closed the chart, her voice calm and cautious.
nr2_026: “But to be safe, don't alert Dr. Sakaguchi yet. OR Three has no cases this afternoon, and its equipment was just inspected. When you collect her from reception, don't introduce yourself. Tell her you're taking her to verify tray specifications in the surgical area, then bring her straight to the pre-op room beside OR Three.”
nr2_027: Ren looked at Narumi and immediately understood her intent.
nr2_028: “Understood. I'll put away my name badge and bring her over now.”
nr2_029: Mika spread her branded product catalogue across the table one page at a time, explaining it in a crisp, efficient cadence.
nr2_030: “These pelvic retractors and atraumatic dissectors use an improved curvature that maintains excellent exposure in a narrow, deep field. The jaws are specially blunted to minimize compression injury to the ovarian cortex and surrounding vessels.”
nr2_031: Narumi calmly studied the specification page:
nr2_032: “You know the specifications and indications by heart. You clearly are an experienced specialist in gynecologic surgical instruments, Ms. Shimotsuki.”
nr2_033: Mika smiled with a trace of pride:
nr2_034: “I handle priority departments at several major hospitals. Without knowing the business, I would never get through a chief surgeon's door.”
nr2_035: “But the catalogue doesn't appear to include long-term clinical follow-up data for this set.”
nr2_036: “That data is still being compiled. I can have the company send it to your purchasing email later.”
nr2_037: As she put away the presentation charts, she changed the subject with studied casualness:
nr2_038: “While researching before my visit, Dr. Jinguji's name seemed familiar. Before Hoshimi, did you work at another very large general hospital?”
nr2_039: “My medical résumé has always been public. It is no secret.”
nr2_040: “That hospital's research platform is famous in the field. Why did you suddenly leave it for a small hospital like this?”
nr2_041: Narumi did not answer immediately. She simply watched Mika steer the conversation toward personnel changes.
nr2_042: Still arranging her folder, Mika added as if it meant nothing:
nr2_043: “I also heard a young nurse left that hospital at about the same time. Nurse Nanase, who brought me here from reception, moved so confidently. She must be an old partner who followed you here then, correct?”
nr2_044: A knock sounded at that exact moment.
nr2_045: Ren entered carrying a tray and casually pulled shut the door from the preparation room to the outer corridor.
nr2_047: She set down the cup but did not turn to leave. Instead she remained by the door, her calm gaze fixed on Mika's face.
nr2_048: Having heard the final sentence outside, Ren understood everything. When collecting Mika, she had deliberately worn an unbadged work coat, never spoken her name, and discussed nothing beyond instrument specifications. Yet this woman had called her “Nurse Nanase” and even knew that she and Narumi came from the same former hospital.
nr2_049: Narumi lifted the teacup without drinking and spoke in an even tone:
nr2_050: “Perfect timing, Nurse Nanase. Ms. Shimotsuki was just taking an interest in our former careers.”
nr2_052: “Just a salesperson's professional habit. I was making conversation.”
nr2_053: Ren remained by the door. Her voice was gentle, but every word was clear:
nr2_054: “If this were a salesperson's professional habit, on the way from the first floor to surgery you would have asked about our tray dimensions and sterilization procedures. But since entering, you have watched the duty roster on the corridor wall, not the instrument cabinets.”
nr2_057: Narumi set down her cup and looked directly into Mika's eyes:
nr2_058: “I have a question as well, Ms. Shimotsuki. Reception never introduced the nursing staff. When Nurse Nanase collected you, she wore no badge and never gave her name. How did you know her surname was Nanase without any introduction?”
nr2_059: Mika's eyes flickered, and she forced a smile:
nr2_060: “I… asked colleagues about your staffing before I came…”
nr2_061: “Hoshimi publishes only attending physicians' profiles. Nursing schedules and employment histories are never public. Even our own colleagues rarely know she once worked at the same hospital as I did.”
nr2_062: Narumi reached out and closed the elegant catalogue on the table, taking in the familiar custom exhibition brooch at Mika's collar as well.
nr2_063: “That concludes the instrument presentation. Now let us discuss something outside the catalogue.”
nr2_064: The air in the preparation room abruptly turned cold.
nr2_065: Caught in her mistake, Mika snatched up her briefcase and sprang to her feet.
nr2_066: “If Dr. Jinguji isn't interested in our products, there must be some misunderstanding. I won't take any more of your time. Goodbye.”
nr2_067: Ren stood quietly before the door without yielding a step.
nr2_068: “Ms. Shimotsuki, please answer Dr. Jinguji first.”
nr2_070: “What are you doing? You have no right to detain me!”
nr2_071: “You're right. So tell us honestly who sent you with a list to confirm that the two of us were at Hoshimi, and I will stop wasting your time.”
nr2_075: The five syllables fell into the silent room, almost soundless.
nr2_076: Mika's pupils contracted violently. Her forced composure shattered, and even the fingers holding her briefcase trembled.
nr2_077: Ren slowly lowered her eyes by the door.
nr2_080: “Move! Don't think hiding in a place like this means you can pretend nothing happened—!”
nr2_081: She spun toward the door and lunged for the handle.
nr2_083: A brief struggle cut her off.
nr2_084: Ren swiftly turned and caught Mika's wrist. At the same instant, Narumi produced a prepared syringe and decisively injected her upper arm.
nr2_085: Mika's eyes widened in terror. Pain flashed through her arm; she tried to scream, but her voice rapidly lost its strength.
nr2_087: Narumi caught her as she slid down the door.
nr2_088: “I know you won't believe me, but I do not enjoy doing this.”
nr2_090: Before she could finish the last word, she lost consciousness completely.
nr2_092: Ren looked down at Mika, then raised her eyes to Narumi.
nr2_093: “Dr. Jinguji, are we really going through with this?”
nr2_094: Narumi looked at her, voice calm and controlled.
nr2_095: “If we stop now, Hirasaka will send a third person tomorrow. Only if she becomes too frightened to involve herself again can we buy time.”
nr2_097: Her customary gentle smile had vanished entirely.
nr2_098: When Mika awoke, the first thing she saw was the preparation room's stark white ceiling.
nr2_099: She lay on a transport bed. Her jacket, skirt, and heels were gone; she now wore a thin patient gown, and a pre-op cap completely contained her hair.
nr2_100: ECG and blood-pressure monitors were connected beside her wrist.
nr2_101: Ren stood beside the bed in green scrubs, checking the instrument readings.
nr2_103: Mika tried to sit up with a violent struggle, but the restraint at the side of the bed held her down.
nr2_104: “What are you trying to do?! Let me go! I'm calling the police!”
nr2_107: Printed clearly at the top of the page were the words:
nr2_110: The signature field also bore a signature almost identical to her own handwriting.
nr2_116: She admitted it so calmly that Mika momentarily forgot what insult should come next.
nr2_117: “I will ask again. What did Ryuji Hirasaka send you here to do?”
nr2_118: Mika bit down hard on her lip:
nr2_121: “Then we will have to talk somewhere else.”
nr2_124: At the far end of the inner passage, the doors to OR Three slowly opened.
nr2_125: The transport bed stopped beside the operating table in OR Three.
nr2_126: Narumi and Ren were the only other people in the room.
nr2_127: Under the glaring surgical lights, Mika saw the narrow operating table and finally understood that the earlier consent form was more than a simple threat.
nr2_128: “No… no! I'm not sick! I don't need any operation!”
nr2_129: Ren stood by the table wearing only green scrubs, cap, and surgical mask. Her voice remained soft, but offered no reassurance.
nr2_131: Narumi and Ren moved Mika onto the operating table and fastened the restraints around both wrists and legs. Mika stared in terror at the neatly arranged metal instruments and heard the faint sounds of cloth, metal, and packaging as Ren opened the preparation set.
nr2_132: Again and again, Mika cried that she had never signed the consent form.
nr2_133: Yet Ren's preoperative preparations did not stop.
nr2_134: Ren silently and expertly completed abdominal hair preparation, urinary catheterization, and povidone-iodine antisepsis in sequence. Once the green sterile fenestrated drapes covered and secured her entire body, only the planned abdominal field remained exposed beneath the surgical lights.
nr2_135: In real surgery, each step served a medical purpose. Here, they were being used to create a hopeless illusion.
nr2_136: Tears slid beneath the edge of Mika's cap as she cried out to Ren beside the table:
nr2_137: “Please… don't cut me! I told you I'm not a patient! Nurse Nanase, you don't look like this kind of person… Make her stop!”
nr2_138: Narumi had changed into a complete sterile gown and gloves and now walked slowly to the surgeon's position.
nr2_139: A surgical mask covered the lower half of her face. Her exposed eyes were almost emotionlessly calm.
nr2_140: “You are not a patient. I know that better than anyone.”
nr2_143: “Because from the moment you entered, you treated this place as someone else's territory.”
nr2_144: She extended a hand toward Ren across the table.
nr2_145: A scalpel was placed in her sterile-gloved palm.
nr2_146: The metal made no unusual sound, yet the immobilized Mika seemed to hear something terrifying.
nr2_147: Narumi did not raise the blade. Instead she gently rested the cold back of the scalpel against the still-unbroken skin of the abdominal field.
nr2_149: Mika broke completely, a scream bursting from her throat:
nr2_150: “Hirasaka! Dr. Hirasaka! It was all his idea!”
nr2_152: Mika shouted through tears and mucus:
nr2_153: “He heard you might be at Hoshimi and told me to confirm it while delivering an instrument catalogue! He wants your current names, jobs, addresses, and exactly how much you've told Director Jogu about the past!”
nr2_156: “Because I sell gynecologic instruments for him! He controls all my contracts with the major hospitals. I owe him favors, and I had a private relationship with him… I took his money, but he also warned that if I refused this errand, he would have every partner hospital blacklist me!”
nr2_158: “Yes! I thought I only had to confirm who was here and ask a few questions! I never meant to hurt you!”
nr2_159: Ren remained by the instrument table, one hand resting lightly over the breast pocket of her scrubs. The miniature recorder concealed inside was running.
nr2_160: Haltingly, Mika disclosed the contact method, payment, and agreed reporting deadline. She spoke so quickly that several times she had to stop and gasp for breath.
nr2_161: Narumi neither lifted nor withdrew the scalpel, as though waiting for a report to reach its final page.
nr2_162: At last, Ren raised her head.
nr2_163: “Dr. Jinguji. She has told us everything.”
nr2_165: Narumi looked at Ren, then drew back her hand and returned the scalpel to the instrument table.
nr2_169: “No one is going to cut you.”
nr2_170: For a moment, Mika could not speak.
nr2_171: After a long while, she finally asked in a trembling, tearful voice:
nr2_172: “From the beginning… this was an act?”
nr2_173: “I never intended to make an incision.”
nr2_175: “How could I possibly know that while I was lying on the table?!”
nr2_176: This time Narumi gave no answer. She and Ren simply began releasing the restraints and removing the drapes and catheter.
nr2_177: Ryuji Sakaguchi had come to the supply room at the end of the surgical wing to verify an inventory record for surgical sutures.
nr2_178: Passing the inner corridor outside OR Three, he saw its indicator light illuminated despite no case being scheduled there that afternoon.
nr2_179: Through the heavy door, he faintly heard a man's name from within.
nr2_181: Sakaguchi stopped. He had recently seen that name on the title page of an old paper in Narumi's office.
nr2_182: Then came a woman's uncontrolled sobbing.
nr2_183: Frowning, Sakaguchi approached the blind angle beside the observation window and looked inside. The operating table was draped. Narumi, in a sterile gown, returned an unstained scalpel to the instrument table and said coldly, “No one is going to cut you… I never intended to make an incision.” Beside her, Ren wore only green scrubs and moved to remove the woman's drapes.
nr2_184: Sakaguchi slowly released his hand from beside the door handle.
nr2_185: The scene clearly exceeded the bounds of normal medical practice. Yet after seeing Narumi put down the scalpel and hearing her explicitly say she would not cut, Sakaguchi did not storm inside to condemn them. He knew something extraordinarily difficult must have driven the normally rule-bound Narumi and Ren to such misconduct inside the hospital.
nr2_186: Footsteps sounded from the other end of the corridor. A duty nurse approached carrying a tray and looked curiously toward the lit OR Three:
nr2_187: “Dr. Sakaguchi? Is there an emergency operation in OR Three this evening?”
nr2_188: Without showing any reaction, Sakaguchi shifted to block the door and spoke calmly:
nr2_189: “There is no operation. I asked Dr. Jinguji and Nurse Nanase to help check the placement of several instruments. They turned on the light and are nearly finished cleaning up.”
nr2_191: “I see. Then I'll get back to work up front.”
nr2_192: After sending her away, Sakaguchi took one final look at the two women cleaning the instruments. Without interrupting, he quietly turned and left the corridor.
nr2_193: Inside, Ren had just removed her mask. Through the observation window she caught sight of the departing white coat and froze slightly:
nr2_194: “Dr. Jinguji… I think that was Dr. Sakaguchi outside.”
nr2_195: Narumi looked at the empty corridor beyond the window, her expression sharpening:
nr2_196: “…First take her to observation. Once we finish dealing with today's situation, we will confess everything to the director.”
nr2_197: In the private observation room, Mika had changed back into her own clothes.
nr2_198: A regular outpatient nurse who had not participated in the afternoon's events had followed standard procedure to measure her blood pressure and heart rate. Only after confirming stable vital signs and no obvious acute abnormality did the nurse leave.
nr2_199: Narumi and Ren now stood at the doorway without approaching her again.
nr2_200: “I will keep the recording secure. I won't give it to Hirasaka.”
nr2_201: Mika looked up, her face darkening further:
nr2_204: “The forged consent form has been destroyed. You may call the police or complain to the director about what happened today. We will not deny it.”
nr2_205: Mika gripped her phone until her knuckles turned white:
nr2_206: “And then what? You hand over the recording of my confession?”
nr2_207: “We cannot decide the consequences for you.”
nr2_208: The phone in Mika's bag vibrated. A message appeared, demanding a progress report.
nr2_209: Mika stared at the screen, her voice rough:
nr2_210: “What am I supposed to say when he asks whether I found you? If I say yes, he'll ask why I stayed in the hospital so long. If I tell him about the operating room, he'll only suspect that I've confessed everything about him.”
nr2_211: She slowly raised her head and looked at the two women by the door:
nr2_212: “You know better than I do what he does to people who betray him, don't you?”
nr2_215: Mika typed rapidly, revised the message several times, and finally pressed send: “Made contact with Hoshimi Hospital as agreed. Found no evidence that either target works here. Recommend no further manpower.”
nr2_216: She held up the successful-send screen for Narumi to see and spoke coldly:
nr2_217: “I told him you aren't here. Not because I trust you. I just… don't want to destroy myself.”
nr2_218: “I won't ask you to thank us.”
nr2_220: Ren placed Mika's briefcase beside the table:
nr2_221: “A car is waiting at the hospital entrance. The driver only knows he is collecting a departing visitor. Whether you take it is your choice.”
nr2_222: Mika picked up the bag and reached the door, then abruptly stopped:
nr2_224: “A doctor and a nurse at Hoshimi Hospital.”
nr2_225: Mika stared at her for a long time, then gave a cold laugh:
nr2_226: “…Today, I don't want to believe that at all.”
nr2_227: With that, she left the hospital without looking back.
nr2_228: After seeing Mika off, Narumi and Ren did not return to the lounge. They went directly to knock on the director's office door.
nr2_229: The recorder lay on the desk beside the written incident reports they had prepared voluntarily.
nr2_230: After hearing the account and confirming that an independent clinician had verified Mika's stable vital signs before departure, Asuka Jogu exhaled softly and regarded them both with a grave expression.
nr2_231: “Neither of you concealed this from me. You came here to confess immediately after seeing her off. I will remember that.”
nr2_232: “Using the spare operating room to frighten a visitor was my decision. I will accept every internal penalty. Please do not implicate the hospital or Ren.”
nr2_234: “Director, I chose to help Dr. Jinguji. If there is punishment, include me too.”
nr2_235: Asuka shook her head. Her tone was not harsh, but the boundary she set was unmistakable:
nr2_236: “I took you into Hoshimi despite the pressure because I wanted you to escape that old environment and practice openly as a doctor and nurse. Even if neither of you ever intended to cut her, using this hospital's operating room as an instrument of intimidation crossed an absolute line. I will seal this record in our internal file, but nothing like it may ever happen again in a Hoshimi operating room. Understood?”
nr2_238: “I understand, Director. There will never be a second time.”
nr2_240: Asuka's expression softened, and one finger lightly touched the final paragraph of their statement:
nr2_241: “But you said Dr. Sakaguchi passed OR Three this evening, heard the disturbance, and deliberately sent away a duty nurse who approached?”
nr2_242: “Yes. He didn't come inside to accuse us, but he must have heard Hirasaka's name.”
nr2_244: “And when Mika Shimotsuki registered this afternoon, she used Dr. Sakaguchi's recent arrival as her excuse. If Hirasaka doesn't fully believe her false report and sends someone else to test us, they may target Dr. Sakaguchi next…”
nr2_245: Asuka considered this, then looked up to ask their opinion:
nr2_246: “Dr. Sakaguchi covered for you at the door, and he is now your most frequent surgical partner. Keeping him in the dark only leaves him vulnerable. Tomorrow morning I will speak with him for ten minutes. Without revealing private details about your former hospital, I will warn him that Hirasaka sent someone to investigate. Do you agree?”
nr2_247: Narumi and Ren exchanged a look and nodded together.
nr2_248: “If it is Dr. Sakaguchi, I agree.”
nr2_250: Early the next morning, Ryuji Sakaguchi came to the director's office as requested.
nr2_251: Asuka pushed a cup of warm tea toward him:
nr2_252: “Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi. I called you before clinic begins. This will take only ten minutes.”
nr2_253: “Good morning, Director. This is about OR Three yesterday evening, isn't it?”
nr2_255: “Nothing gets past you. After Narumi and Ren saw off that saleswoman, Mika Shimotsuki, they came straight to me last night to confess and accept punishment. They made a point of telling me that you helped by sending away the nurse outside.”
nr2_257: “I saw they were already finishing. There was no need for anyone else to stumble onto the scene.”
nr2_259: “When you saw a doctor and nurse you trust clearly violating the rules in a spare operating room, did you never consider going straight inside to stop them?”
nr2_260: “I saw Dr. Jinguji put the scalpel down herself and heard her say she would not cut. Once I knew no one would be harmed, barging in would only have made the situation more chaotic.”
nr2_262: “What they did yesterday crossed a line, and I reprimanded them severely. But you saw that they did not intend to hurt anyone and gave them room to finish. I am sure they are grateful.”
nr2_263: “In clinical work, they follow the rules more strictly than anyone. Rather than storm in to accuse them, I wanted to know what trouble had driven them that far.”
nr2_265: “Exactly. If they hadn't been cornered, why would those two have resorted to such a dangerous method of protecting themselves?”
nr2_266: Asuka let the smile fade and earnestly explained the situation to Sakaguchi:
nr2_267: “With Narumi and Ren's consent, I asked you here today to bring you into our confidence. At the hospital controlled by Ryuji Hirasaka, they endured terrible coercion and paid a great price to escape. When they were blacklisted in medicine and had almost nowhere left to go, I recruited them into Hoshimi.”
nr2_268: “So Mika Shimotsuki was an investigator Hirasaka sent to find them.”
nr2_269: “Yes. To protect herself, Mika sent Hirasaka a false report saying she found no evidence they worked here, but a man like him may not believe it easily. She also deliberately used your name at reception yesterday. If Hirasaka tries a more discreet probe next, he may approach your surgical clinic directly.”
nr2_271: “Understood. If I notice anything unusual in clinic or among referrals, I will report it immediately.”
nr2_272: “There is one more thing. When they left this office last night, both were deeply uneasy. They feared that after seeing yesterday's scene, you would consider them dangerous and refuse to work with them again.”
nr2_273: “I don't approve of yesterday's method, but the Dr. Jinguji and Nurse Nanase I know are more than what I saw in that operating room.”
nr2_275: “That sounds exactly like you. Hearing you say it puts my mind completely at ease.”
nr2_276: “They have admitted their mistake to the director, so that page is finished. The next time trouble comes from outside, we will face it together.”
nr2_278: “With those words, the weight on both their hearts can finally lift.”
nr2_279: The wall clock completed exactly ten minutes and pointed to eight fifty.
nr2_281: “There. Exactly ten minutes. I needn't relay the message for you. Those two have probably been waiting in the corridor to read your expression this whole time.”
nr2_282: Sakaguchi said goodbye, opened the office door, and stepped outside.
nr2_283: In the sunlight at the corridor corner, Narumi and Ren had indeed stopped on their way to the clinic and ward.
nr2_284: At the sound of the door, they turned together. The normally composed Narumi's fingers tightened slightly, while Ren watched him with open unease.
nr2_285: “D-Dr. Sakaguchi… Is the director finished talking to you?”
nr2_286: Sakaguchi looked at their tense expressions and lifted his clipboard as naturally as he did before daily rounds.
nr2_287: “We're finished. Clinic begins in ten minutes. Dr. Jinguji, have you checked the pre-op assessment for this afternoon's operation?”
nr2_288: Narumi froze for an instant. The guarded tension in her eyes quietly melted like snow, and her usual warm, intelligent smile returned.
nr2_289: “It is checked. We can operate at any time.”
nr2_291: “Nurse Nanase, what about this morning's ward handoff?”
nr2_292: Ren's eyes lit up. She nodded vigorously, smiling brightly:
nr2_293: “Everything is confirmed! We can start whenever you're ready, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
